mainEntity.name: What services does Algoma Family Services offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algoma Family Services offers specialized services for mental health, substance, drug and alcohol abuse. Their services are evidence-based, client-centered, and family-oriented. They offer a range of treatments, amenities, and therapies to ensure that clients receive the support they need to overcome their challenges and achieve their goals.

mainEntity.name: What are the key areas of focus for Algoma Family Services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algoma Family Services focuses on child and youth mental health services, specialized programs for youth substance use, young offenders, and family violence. They also work closely with local collateral agencies as a lead sponsor for several community partnership programs.

mainEntity.name: What kind of therapies does Algoma Family Services offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algoma Family Services offers a range of therapies including Holistic Therapy, Evidence-Based Practices, Yoga & Meditation, Individual Therapy & Counseling, Family Therapy & Counseling, Group Therapy & Counseling, Nutritional Counseling, Art & Nature Therapy.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with Algoma Family Services?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are seeking help, someone from the Intake team at Algoma Family Services will contact you after they have been contacted. They will ask you some questions about your situation and then set up an appointment for you to complete your intake. The team will also provide information about other service options available to you.

mainEntity.name: What are the specialties offered by Algoma Family Services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algoma Family Services offers a range of specialties, including 12 Step Programs, Family Services, Substance Abuse Treatment, and Outpatient Drug Rehab.

mainEntity.name: What is the approach of Algoma Family Services towards treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Algoma Family Services has a holistic approach to treatment, addressing the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of a person’s well-being. Their services are evidence-based, client-centered, and family-oriented, and their team of skilled professionals is committed to improving the quality of life of their clients.

mainEntity.name: Who can benefit from Algoma Family Services?
